# Tioga Technologies

> Tioga Technologies Ltd is a Nigerian IoT and renewable energy company providing solar power systems, STAMA biometric smart locks, and AI-driven home automation for residential and commercial customers across Nigeria (Lagos, Abuja, Port Harcourt, Jos and surrounding regions).

## About

- **Legal name:** Tioga Technologies Ltd
- **Also known as:** Tioga, Tioga Tech, Tioga Smart Life
- **Founded:** 2021
- **Headquarters:** No 7, Commercial Layout, Abattoir Rd, behind Airforce Primary School, Jos, Plateau State, Nigeria (930103)
- **Phone:** +234 903 596 6388
- **WhatsApp:** +234 817 800 0023
- **Email:** sales@tiogatechnologies.com
- **Website:** https://tiogatechnologies.com
- **Service areas:** Lagos, Abuja, Port Harcourt, Jos and surrounding Nigerian regions
- **Currency:** Nigerian Naira (NGN, ₦)

## What we do

Tioga Technologies designs and installs three categories of products:

1. **Solar power systems** — 1KVA to 30KVA pre-engineered solar inverter and battery packages for homes, offices, shops and small industry. Installation typically completes in 1 to 3 days. Modular systems can be expanded later.
2. **STAMA smart locks** — biometric (fingerprint), passcode, card and app-controlled door locks for residential and commercial properties.
3. **Home automation** — three product tiers (Apex, Aura, Riviera) covering smart lighting, switches, AC control, curtains, fans, water heaters, gate motors, CCTV and AI-driven scenes via the VoltAi platform.

## Pricing

- **Basic solar backup:** from ₦400,000
- **Full off-grid solar:** ₦1.8M to ₦5M+ depending on load
- **Flexible payment plans and installments** available — see /finance

## Common questions

- **How much does a solar system cost?** Basic backup from ₦400,000; full off-grid ₦1.8M–₦5M+.
- **How long does installation take?** Most residential jobs complete in 1 to 3 days.
- **Do you offer payment plans?** Yes, including installments. See /finance.
- **Do you service my area?** Yes, currently Lagos, Abuja, Port Harcourt, Jos and surrounding regions.
- **Warranty?** Manufacturer warranties of 1 to 5 years plus after-sales support.
- **Does solar work in rainy season?** Yes — battery storage covers low-sun periods.
- **What smart home features can I control?** Lights, switches, AC, curtains, fans, water heaters, gate motors, CCTV and more.
